notes.title: BWM Collector's Edition Patch Notes v 1.1.0
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31871785/31e0b8ad88c3deabd272a4c978663c4f9768c8e0.png

Replaceable Dev#58: Hey there, boys and girls… And bears.

Recently there have been a lot of reports from you guys about the collectors edition default input device. We were busy with some other stuff lately but we finally got around to it. Thank you guys for the patience and support…

Amber: Ugh, this is boring stuff… Soooo boring, omg, I’m dying…

Replaceable Dev#58: Umm, but it’s the patch notes, I have to keep it short and to the point and…

Amber: You’re just the worst… Let me!

Replaceable Dev#58: (sighs)

Amber: Heeeeeey, um… You guys! 
These dorks over here fixed some boring stuff I don’t really care about… If you really want to know you can check it out below. But I on the other hand made that horsie up there, look at it! 

So cute, right? 😊


Fixes 

    Game Progress Migration
Episode 2 CE is now unlocked if standalone episode 1 has been finished, also episode 3 CE is unlocked if standalone episode 2 has been finished

    Defaulting to Gamepad
Game no longer defaults to gamepad, it defaults to keyboard and mouse. Added "Default to gamepad" setting to enable switching and defaulting to gamepad

    Achivements 
Achievements from standalone episodes are now translated to collectors edition upon next BWM CE game start

    Few Localisation Updates 
 

Not Yet Fixed 

    Save Transfer
We are working on it. It should be up soon.
 


TL;DR Fixed things, I guess… Also boring. But also horsie <3

#blessed #horsies #amberisgenius #sotalented #likeomg

notes.title: BWM Episode 3 Update v2.0.0.
notes.notes:
Added short cutscene after credits screen
Updated some achievements graphics
Ambient sounds now play through SFX channel
Minor localisation fixes
Ted does not have Utility Belt after Police Station gameplay anymore (he returned it to CBG)
Skyscraper base, misleading Walkie-Talkie hint swapped with better one
Tweaked various sounds, animations and assets, done better processing for some voice overlays, added thunder sounds on various scenes, adjusted rain VFX etc.

Have a great Halloween and watch out for the Red menace that is troubling the Paper City, where is he, can you stop him and save the city from the fires and total destruction!?

notes.title: BWM Episode 3 Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Bug fixes

Police Entrance inventory highlight animation bug solved
Evidence Room boxing gloves hotspot moved to actually cover boxing gloves
Endless Forest visual glitch solved

Updates

BWM episode 3 now can be run using .exe file (not only through Steam play option)
Added localisation for game intro text, scene transitions text and "The End" text
Various visual and sound adjustments i.e. Fireplace Thongs animation polish, Amber slow walk polish, various voice over files replaced with higher quality ones, Comics related graphic adjustments...

Enjoy playing Episode 3 of Bear With Me with the latest fixes and updates, we're trying to make it better with every day. Thank you for bearing with us and wish you a lot of Bear puns and adventures on your way to solving the mystery of the “Red Men“! 😉

notes.title: BWM Episode 3 Update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
- Solved the issue with the Save file created during Vault puzzle before update 1.1.0, it was broken with update 1.1.0, and now it should be working
- Vault related small adjustments, leaving the Vault puzzle closeup automatically resets the Vault puzzle, if at least one teeth is not retracted
- The player cannot return to Lookout scene using back button on city map anymore, since Lookout scene is a cutscene
- Polish, various visual and sound related adjustments i.e. implemented Mural projection light flicker effect, Pier sea animation, Vault scene visuals are now synced with Vault puzzle visuals, added Love Key related visuals and sound, applied various color corrections...

Wish you all a great time and lots of adventures with our detective duo, there are questions to be answered and puzzles to be solved, follow the clues, snoop around, have fun! 😉

notes.title: BWM Episode 02 - Update v2.2.0
notes.notes:
Save/Autosave

- fixed issue where the data from Episode 1 was not transferred into Episode 2.
• item transfer from Episode 1 Inventory to Episode 2 Inventory 
• we collect Episode 1 data from your last Episode 1 save or autosave file
• the last save or autosave file is the one with the latest date/time
• you need to create a new save or autosave slot in Episode 1, after that you need to run Episode 2 and doing so you'll get data transferred from Episode 1 to Episode 2 
• this is a temporary data transfer system, we are working on a better solution for this issue that will not rely on the last save or autosave file
